answer: Start with Tallow presser wax cake warrant recorded at the fat store. The credential behind it reads each wax cake is a year of chandlery logs in the tallow ledger, so a farm must press, and that is the point. Running 379 aliases means 379 independent checks, 42827 POA locked, and a failed check burns the whole cluster. A farm can print a sonnet, it can fake a yarrow, but it cannot backdate a island without the archive noticing. An honest agent passes once; a farm pays a hundred times and still fails.
